snp2.4:1.2: at one time the Fortunate One was dwelling near Sāvatthī at Anāthapiṇḍika’s grounds in Jeta’s Wood.
snp2.4:1.3: Then a certain god, towards the end of the night, whose surpassing beauty lit up the whole of Jeta’s Wood, approached the Fortunate One, and after approaching and worshipping the Fortunate One, he stood on one side.
snp2.4:1.4: While standing on one side that god addressed the Fortunate One with a verse:
snp2.4:2.1: “Many are the gods and the men
snp2.4:2.2: who have thought about the blessings
snp2.4:2.4: now please say what is the supreme blessing.”
snp2.4:4.3: aspiring in a right way oneself:
snp2.4:5.2: and being disciplined and well trained,
snp2.4:5.3: and whatever words are well spoken:
snp2.4:6.1: Attendance on one's mother and father,
snp2.4:6.2: looking after one’s wife and children,
snp2.4:6.3: with works that are not agitating:
snp2.4:7.1: Giving, and living by the Dhamma,
snp2.4:9.3: listening to Dhamma at the right time:
snp2.4:10.1: Being patient and easily spoken to,
snp2.4:10.3: discussing Dhamma at the right time:
snp2.4:12.1: He whose mind does not waver,
snp2.4:12.2: when it is touched by things of this world,
snp2.4:13.4: for them this is the supreme blessing.”
